title: Medical Supplies Company for Sale in Mohali, India
tagline: Established medical equipment manufacturer based in Mohali, Punjab, specializing in Medical X-ray, C-arm image intensifier, and ESWL Lithotripter equipment. - The company has been operating for over three decades and serves doctors, hospitals, and healthcare institutions. - The business has 100+ customers, with a significant portion of sales coming from exports, supported by local dealers across North India. - Dealers assist customers with equipment installation and after-sales maintenance, providing an established distribution and service network. - The company operates from a self-owned 500 sq. yard, double-storey factory in Mohali, equipped with fabrication, powder coating, electronic, and electrical production infrastructure. - The facility has an expected monthly production capacity of approximately INR 20 lakh. - The business currently has 10 employees and is operated as a family-owned Private Limited Company with two directors. - Current sales are below historical potential due to zero marketing expenditure, presenting an opportunity for growth through stronger marketing and management.
